visual_synopsis: An elderly woman with white hair and a red neck scarf sits at a table under a red wall carpet dictating to a bespectacled young man in a yellow shirt and grey vest, who writes it all down on a yellow pad. He puts on a brown coat and she sees him out at the front door pressing the folded yellow pages on him, but he turns up at her door again with the pad and pen still in hand, grinning, while in between she sits alone with a mug watching the television.
